authorization: User asked to speed lens readouts without changing the frozen protocol or losing progress.
scope: Storage and scheduling only. No frozen gen27b runner bytes, numerical code, prompts, cases, layers, precision, lens weights, rank calculations, bootstrap, random seeds, controls, or core results change.
observed_bottleneck: The worker waits on fuse.geesefs persistent-volume operations. Controlled 501-byte append/flush/fsync/close benchmark: median .3755s at 12MB vs .0849s empty and .1189s at 64KB; local-disk control .0001-.0002s. Root disk is not used as the authoritative journal.
concurrent_incident: At 22:35:22Z the existing lens runner caught FileNotFoundError in os.fsync and wrote appendix_deferred.json. Original data and error report retained. This is a storage error, not an experimental-implementation repair.
durability: Every new row retains the original JSON serialization and a successful flush+fsync on the SAME persistent volume. An immutable byte-identical prefix plus append-only chunks of at most 128 rows replace repeated uploads of the growing canonical file. No unflushed batching and no ephemeral-only checkpoint.
completion: Assemble canonical lens_ranks.jsonl from prefix and chunks with one durable atomic replacement at the original completion boundary; keep all chunks. Existing scorecard and completion code executes unchanged.
resume: Validate adapter/spec/model identities and prefix checksum; reject duplicate keys, interior corruption and changed identities; repair only torn final-chunk tail. Consolidation followed by another resume neither drops nor duplicates rows.
verification: Four CPU tests passed: byte-identical output to original Journal across restart and consolidation/restart; retained immutable prefix; torn-last-tail recovery; identity/duplicate rejection; interior corruption rejection. All old frozen gen27b file hashes must still match existing run_header.json.
operations: Safely pause via PAUSE, back up canonical journal and incident, archive transient deferred/battery markers without deleting them, resume through same GPU lock, requeue waiting O-lens after removing only the agent-owned PAUSE token.
performance_claim: Expected storage speedup is supported by small-file benchmark; final wall time is measured after resume and not assumed from GPU utilization.
